description: This file contains validation rules for form fields used in the OrangeHRM project, including functions for required fields, character length limits, range validation, digit and email validation, phone number format, and special character restrictions.

methods.name: required
methods.description: Validates if the value is present and not empty; supports string, number, array, and object types.

methods.name: shouldNotExceedCharLength
methods.description: Returns a validation function that checks if a string's length does not exceed a specified maximum.

methods.name: validRange
methods.description: Returns a validation function that checks if a numeric string falls within a specified range and length.

methods.name: digitsOnly
methods.description: Validates that a string contains only digits.

methods.name: validEmailFormat
methods.description: Validates that a string matches the email format.

methods.name: validPhoneNumberFormat
methods.description: Validates that a string contains only valid phone number characters.

methods.name: shouldNotLessThanCharLength
methods.description: Returns a validation function that checks if a string is at least a specified length.

methods.name: shouldNotContainSpecialChars
methods.description: Returns a validation function that ensures a string contains only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

ctags.name: digitsOnly
ctags.pattern: /^export const digitsOnly = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: validEmailFormat
ctags.pattern: /^export const validEmailFormat = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/
